text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I bumped into Eishin Flash in town.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Falcon-san.
Are you out and about with your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪
Even Umadols need to take a break sometimes☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I heard you had the Trainer tutor you before, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The reason Falcon-san has needed fewer makeup lessons
lately must be thanks to your great teaching, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey now, Flash-san!?
Don't bring up remedial lessons for an Umadol right in the middle of the street~!?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...? I simply thought you were a great mentor, Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san can be an airhead sometimes...
She really didn't need to bring that story up~.
choice_data_list: You're working hard on your studies, huh.
You're working hard on your studies, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, 'cause without remedial classes, you can give your all to training and concerts, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To become a top umadol,
I still need to put in a whole, whole lot more effort!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She really is trying to overcome her weaknesses
on her own initiative. In that case..."
choice_data_list: I'll take you somewhere as a reward.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! Yay♪
Where should we go...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then to get back to our roots,
let's go on a Falco holy pilgrimage tour☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, do you remember the first
Debut Selection race we took on together, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's the course I always run on,
but somehow it feels so nostalgic! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I practiced super hard at karaoke, so now I can even sing rock and enka☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate Umadol has gotta be ready
to cover any kind of song☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This street live right here was where
Falco and Trainer first met, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "...Thanks to you, Trainer, I've been able to keep giving it my all in both lives and races."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's why Falco is super grateful☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what an emotional sunset☆
It makes me want to sing♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon was shining brightly, just like
the very first time I saw her perform at a live.
choice_data_list: I'm glad I got to be your trainer.
I'm so glad I got to be your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon was shining brightly, just like
the very first time I saw her perform at a live.
choice_data_list: I'm glad I got to be your trainer.
I'm so glad I got to be your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Turn around when your name is called☆
Bringing a sparkle straight to your heart☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Full of sparkling, thrilling dreams☆
It's the strongest Umadol☆ Smart Falcon☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha♪ The best person in the whole world
at call-and-response with Falco is you, Trainer☆
choice_data_list: That's what years of experience will do for you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yup☆ I'm so glad you're my fan #1, Trainer, and my partner chasing our dreams together♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I'll work even harder from now on,
so stay by my side forever, okay?☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Before I realized it, I was applauding.
Her singing and dancing had improved, making her shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehe☆ Thank youuu☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To thank you for the compliment,
Falco's got a special present for you☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, taking the photo~☆
Three, two, one☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Here's a special photo from my pilgrimage, an exclusive bonus just for my number one fan, Trainer☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Let's keep making lots of memories
together with Falco from now on, okay?☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm really, really glad
you became my Trainer, too...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If things had stayed that way, I'm sure...
I would have kept stubbornly trying to run on turf...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I might never have realized
that you can become a sparkling Umadol on dirt too."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Saying it out loud like this
is kinda embarrassing, isn't it? Ehehe☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, Falco feels like she needs more experience
before she can become a top Umadol...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The road ahead might still be steep, but...
As long as you're with me, Trainer, I can do my best!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So, I'm counting on you from now on too, okay? ☆
